entity.name: EDDI Solutions
entity.description: EDDI Solutions builds and maintains EDDI, an open-source, config-driven middleware for orchestrating conversational AI agents. Funding pays for maintainer time on security hardening, compliance features, documentation and long-term maintenance of the open-source project.

projects.name: EDDI
projects.description: EDDI (Enhanced Dialog Driven Interface) is an open-source multi-agent orchestration middleware for conversational AI. Agent behaviour is defined in versioned JSON configurations and executed by a Java/Quarkus engine: a lifecycle pipeline of rules, API calls and LLM tasks across 19 model providers, with persistent memory, RAG, group conversations, human-in-the-loop approvals, an MCP server and client, a secrets vault, an audit ledger and GDPR tooling. It runs on MongoDB or PostgreSQL and ships with a web Manager and Chat UI.
